identity.context: Sect. IX Of The Measures Of Allegiance · Part III Of The Other Virtues And Vices · Sect. III Of Goodness And Benevolence

items.text: The governing problem is how a science confined to perceptual materials can explain mental productivity, ordered experience, factual assent, and practical reality without appealing to inaccessible essence or independently given forms.

The global thesis is anti-additive: simple content derives from impressions, while order, space, time, existence, and belief contribute no autonomous elemental content beyond the perceptions they organize or intensify.

The architecture differentiates three irreducible explanatory dimensions: provenance determines available content, relation and order determine configuration, and force determines cognitive and practical efficacy.
Sensation asymmetrically grounds ideas, but ideas return as productive relays within reflection, memory, imagination, association, belief, passion, and action.
Mental organization proceeds through preservation, release, recombination, associative weighting, and spatiotemporal arrangement rather than through either passive copying or sovereign creation.
Because existence adds no representational content, actuality is reconstructed as regulated vivacity transferred from present impressions through customary relations to absent or future ideas.

The subject consequently becomes a relay and regulator within a distributed perception-machine, while reality becomes operationally available through stable effects rather than intrinsic representation.
Anomalies and counterfeits do not terminate the machine; they recursively force universal claims to mutate into qualified regularities governed by provenance, steadiness, scope, and correction.

The movement is spiral: empirical restriction → perceptual decomposition → recursive mediation → relational organization → ontological de-addition → intensive actualization → second-order correction → bounded closure at unknown origins and unrepresented reality.
[Attractor] A science of human nature must reconstruct the perceptual medium through which evidence, inference, belief, and every other science operate.
[Persistent] Legitimate inquiry proceeds from experienced perceptions, operations, relations, and effects rather than from speculative access to mental or external essence.
[Persistent] Simple ideational content is asymmetrically dependent on antecedent impression-material, even when later ideas become causally productive.

[Emergent] Provenance, arrangement, and force constitute distinct explanatory coordinates: what an idea contains, how it is ordered, and how efficaciously it is conceived cannot be reduced to one another.
[Mutating] The idea is first a derivative copy, then a recombinable component, an associative node, and finally a force-bearing mediator of belief, passion, and action.
[Attractor] Mental production is asymmetrically recursive: sensory grounding remains one-way, while downstream perceptions repeatedly exchange the roles of effect, antecedent, and regulator.
[Emergent] Novelty is relational and intensive rather than elemental: new complexes, abstractions, expectations, and reality-effects arise without unprecedented simple content.
[Mutating] Order changes from a preserved feature of experience into a manipulable arrangement, an associative pathway, and the constitutive form of spatial and temporal appearance.
[Emergent] Stable mental regularity is generated by associative tendency and custom, which constrain transitions without imposing demonstrative necessity or abolishing imaginative variation.
[Persistent] Space and time are content-bearing orders of coexistence and succession, not independent impressions or empty containers.
[Emergent] Existence contributes no additional represented quality; factuality must therefore be generated through a difference in the manner and force of conception.
[Mutating] Force and vivacity develop from taxonomic marks into transmissible causal quantities, then into regulated quantities whose epistemic status depends on pedigree and steadiness.
[Emergent] A present impression anchors inference, supplies transferable vivacity, and gives absent or future objects current motivational efficacy.

[Attractor] Practical reality is stable, regulated presence within the perception-system: an idea becomes real for the mind insofar as it persistently governs inference, passion, expectation, and conduct.
[Emergent] Epistemic legitimacy is genealogical and second-order: it requires admissible content, permissible relational application, and a force-producing history capable of surviving correction.

[Terminal] Explanation terminates at maximally general experienced relations while sensory origins, associative attraction, external actuality, and the final authority of corrective rules remain undisclosed.
[Stable identity] Experience remains the admissible field from the initial science of human nature through compositional analysis and the genealogy of factual assent.
[Functional recurrence] Observation mutates into perceptual classification, source-audit, compositional decomposition, tracking of associative effects, and diagnosis of force-producing pedigrees.
[Escalation] The copy principle moves from a claim about simple ideas to a general constraint on imagination, abstraction, spatiotemporal predication, and existential representation.
[Mutation] The idea changes from faint effect into reflective cause, recombinable component, associated transition-node, and practically efficacious object of belief.
[Mutation] Order changes from a standard of mnemonic fidelity into the common machinery of recombination, association, extension, duration, and customary expectation.
[Domain migration] Association moves from a gentle relation among freely recombinable ideas into the customary mechanism that selects factual alternatives and transmits vivacity.

[Escalation and reversal] Vivacity progresses from perception-classification and mnemonic discrimination to belief-production, then reverses when poetry, passion, and madness show that intensity cannot warrant itself.
[Absorption] Existence disappears as an independent content-question after its non-addition becomes the constraint forcing factual difference into modal and causal explanation.
[Reversal] Separability first authorizes imaginative liberty, then becomes a negative test excluding empty space, bare time, and other structures detached from every positive content.
[Escalation] Causation migrates from temporal dependence and ideational association to productive capacity, social authority, force transmission, and the regulation of belief.
[Terminal transformation] Ignorance changes from a disciplinary deficiency into a constitutive boundary permitting operational explanation without essential, causal, or metaphysical completion.

[Disappearance through absorption] Separate faculty names lose final explanatory status as memory, imagination, judgment, passion, and volition become differentiated operations within one distributed perception-system.
[Local] The initial diagnosis of philosophical controversy motivates the metascientific project but does not govern the later machinery of order, association, and belief.
[Local] The missing shade remains an exception to strict copy-priority rather than an alternative source of the current-level architecture.
[Local] Exact mnemonic vivacity, the sensory source of extension, and content-filled minima remain local criteria whose broader function is only to constrain unconstrained separation.
[Local] The exhaustiveness of the three associative relations and the extension of causation into social subordination are domain-specific claims, not universal axioms of the whole meta-cluster.
[Scales upward] The prohibition on essence-first explanation becomes the common boundary governing perceptions, faculties, space, time, existence, belief, and reality.
[Scales upward] The copy principle becomes a general genealogy of admissible content, while the distinction between content and operation prevents genealogy from collapsing into passive replay.
[Bridge] Ideas connect sensory derivation to reflection, memory, recombination, association, factual belief, and practical action.
[Bridge] Association and custom connect relational order to intensive actuality by converting recurrent transitions into channels of transferred vivacity.
[Catalyst] Poetry, eloquence, passion, and madness are local cases that scale only as stress tests forcing belief to mutate from raw vividness into regulated intensity.

[Superseded and recoded] Linear copy chronology, passive receptivity, sealed faculties, empty forms, and intrinsic actuality-markers are replaced by asymmetrical recursion, relational organization, and second-order genealogy.
Mental science is not deduction from a known substance, essence, or standpoint external to the faculties under investigation.
No operation of memory, imagination, abstraction, association, or belief can generally originate unprecedented simple content.
Copy-dependence entails neither passive replay nor preservation of every original conjunction, order, intensity, or practical effect.
Relations, order, space, and time are not independent substances or additional simple impressions superadded to their terms.
Existence and belief are not predicates or representational components attached to an otherwise incomplete object-idea.
Mental regularity is neither demonstrative necessity nor random succession; factual assent likewise cannot be generated by conceptual contradiction alone.
No intrinsic semantic feature distinguishes an actual object from the same object merely conceived, and no positive representation discloses extra-perceptual being as such.
Felt intensity, imaginative completeness, repetition, or rhetorical force cannot independently authenticate factual conviction.
The subject is neither a sovereign creator nor an autonomous judge insulated from custom, association, affect, bodily condition, and recursive correction.
Scientific adequacy does not require access to ultimate sensory causes, the metaphysical basis of association, or the intrinsic nature of external actuality.
The architecture requires the falsity of any model in which cognition can ground itself from outside perceptual mediation.
It excludes first-cause foundationalism: knowledge of stable derivative relations cannot depend on prior disclosure of their ultimate origin.
It rejects both the passive receptacle and sovereign producer, requiring a mind that transforms inherited materials without becoming their absolute source.
It disqualifies independent forms and empty frameworks: no positive order, space, time, relation, or generality survives the removal of all content-bearing terms.
It excludes direct representational realism and any intrinsic actuality-sign capable of transporting thought beyond perceptual content into the essence of external being.
It excludes rationalist factuality: conceivability, contradiction, and necessary connection cannot select among contrary matters of fact.
It cannot identify causal genesis with epistemic warrant, because the same associative and intensive mechanisms can produce ordinary belief, education, persuasion, fiction, and pathology.
It cannot admit an independent tribunal of correction without violating perceptual closure, yet it cannot abandon correction without collapsing factual belief into successful vivification.
The first governing absence is absolute sensory origin: sensation grounds the entire machine while the cause of its first appearance remains outside it.
The second governing absence is pure order without ordered content: relation, empty space, bare time, and wholly indeterminate generality are inadmissible.
The third governing absence is a necessary mental bond: association and custom occupy its functional place while remaining defeasible tendencies.
The deepest ontological absence is positively knowable mind-independent actuality; reality persists as correlate, anchor, and corrective term without becoming represented essence.
The absent subject is a sovereign spontaneous origin capable of creating content, governing transitions, and certifying its own beliefs without inherited impressions or natural tendencies.
The terminal absence is a noncircular authority for general rules: correction must regulate force from within the same customary perception-system whose products it evaluates.
Restriction of primitive content produces rather than suppresses mental productivity: impression-derived elements become recursively recombinable, associatively routable, and intensively variable.
The full architecture requires a three-axis audit: genealogy tests content, relational analysis tests configuration and application, and force-pedigree tests factual assent.
Space, time, existence, and belief obey one de-additive rule: apparent higher-order structures are reconstructed as arrangements or modes of perception rather than additional ingredients.

Ideas are the machine’s central switching elements because they preserve sensory derivation while serving as causes of reflection, units of recombination, nodes of association, and bearers of practical reality.
Association becomes the bridge between formal order and factuality: recurrent relations first stabilize imaginative transitions and then channel vivacity from present impressions into belief.
Time has a dual generated structure: succession produces duration, while present impressions project force across succession so that remembered, absent, and future objects act now.

Fiction divides along two independent axes: a complex may be compositionally legitimate because its materials are admissible yet doxastically counterfeit because its vivacity lacks regulated factual pedigree.
Epistemic reading must become recursively genealogical, tracing not only where an idea’s content originated but also how its arrangement and degree of conviction were produced.

The system yields practical realism without positive metaphysical realism: perceptually generated ideas can organize conduct as realities despite lacking an intrinsic representation of independent actuality.

Power operates through two linked channels: productive capacity associates authority and obedience, while rhetoric, repetition, and affect modulate the vivacity by which such relations become practically compelling.

The system’s principal operator is also its principal debt: causation establishes perceptual dependence, associative priority, social power, force transfer, and corrective pedigree before its own nature is secured.
Because corrective rules arise within the same associative field they regulate, epistemic security can only be reflexive, comparative, and qualified rather than absolutely foundational.
The meta-cluster produces an anti-additive ontology: apparent mental and formal entities are reconstructed as sourced contents, relational configurations, or intensive modes.
Mind becomes a distributed transformation machine rather than a substance or faculty hierarchy: it receives, copies, preserves, separates, routes, intensifies, and regulates perceptions.
Actuality becomes a system-effect generated when admissible content is placed within a stable associative route and supplied with regulated practical force.
The subject is decentered twice: it is neither the source of primitive content nor the sovereign author of the order and force by which its ideas govern it.
Time is neither an empty continuum nor simple chronology; it is generated succession recursively reorganized by memory, expectation, custom, and present force-transfer.
Agency becomes navigational: freedom consists in recombination, selective attention, rerouting, and reflective correction within constraints imposed by content, association, and affect.
Scientific foundation is converted into recursive self-audit: secure inquiry tracks sources, relations, force-transfers, anomalies, and corrections while refusing claims to absolute origin.

Political and rhetorical vulnerability is structural rather than accidental because the same relational and intensive machinery that enables authority, expectation, and action also permits capture by repetition, eloquence, and passion.
The machine generates qualified naturalism: explanatory closure belongs to recurrent operations and effects, while metaphysical closure is systematically withheld.

sections.name: Recursive Loops, Escalation Paths, and Conceptual Attractors

items.text: Total production loop: sensation → idea → reflection → memory or imagination → associative routing → belief → passion and action → renewed vivification or reflective correction.

Restriction–proliferation loop: simple content is constrained → complexes are recombined → relations stabilize transitions → force actualizes selected complexes → new reflective effects return to the system.
Genealogical audit loop: impression-source → permissible operation → application test → force-pedigree → correction → renewed audit of the resulting perception.
Order loop: experienced arrangement → mnemonic conservation → imaginative release → associative regeneration → spatiotemporal constitution → customary expectation.
Actualization loop: present impression → customary transition → transferred vivacity → factual belief → practical efficacy → passion → amplified object-idea.
Counterfeit-correction loop: nonstandard vivification → belief-like force → error or capture → source-reflection → general-rule discounting → graded restoration of conviction.

Boundary loop: inquiry reaches inaccessible origin or reality → withdraws to observable effects → formulates a qualified regularity → encounters anomaly → restricts scope without abandoning the machine.

Attractor convergence: ideas organize recursive production, order organizes relational form, regulated vivacity organizes actuality, and inaccessible reality remains the recessed term around which correction circulates.

sections.name: Formal Generative Schema of the Whole Book

items.text: Scientific dependence on human faculties → human nature installed as the metascientific field.
Unavailable essence and ultimate origin → experienced perceptions, operations, relations, and effects become the admissible evidence.
Perceptual decomposition → impressions/ideas + simple/complex → isolable units of provenance and operation.
Sensory grounding + ideational return → asymmetrically recursive perception-chain.
Recurrence differentiated by force and fidelity → memory preserves experienced order while imagination releases components for recombination.
Free recombination + recurrent regularity → resemblance, contiguity, and causation weight transitions without necessitating them.
Analysis of organized content → coexistence and succession reconstructed as extension and duration rather than empty forms.
Existential non-addition + content invariance → factual difference relocated from representation to manner of conception.
Present impression + customary relation → transferred vivacity → steady intensified idea → belief → passion and action.
Affective amplification or counterfeit vivification → source-sensitive reflection and general rules → qualified correction without metaphysical closure.
Foundational disorder → human faculties identified as the common medium of scientific judgment.
Human mediation → empirical restriction → mental life decomposed into perceptions and genealogical dependencies.
Linear copy genealogy → division of impressions → ideas become recursively productive mediators.
Productive ideas → memory/imagination bifurcation → separation and recombination of inherited contents.
Free recombination → associative regulation → stable but defeasible relational pathways.
Relational analysis → space and time reconstructed as content-bearing coexistence and succession.
Existential non-addition → belief-surplus problem → customary force-transfer → practical actualization.
Counterfeit vivacity → second-order genealogy → regulated conviction → unresolved return to unrepresented reality.
Foundation is reclassified from possession of first causes into disciplined reconstruction of perceptual provenance, organization, and force.
Mind is remapped from substance and faculty hierarchy into a recursive field of perceptions differentiated by source, order, transition, and intensity.
Content, relation, and force become separable analytic dimensions, allowing identical materials to support memory, fiction, abstraction, belief, or practical action.
The opposition between receptivity and productivity collapses into asymmetric recursion, while the opposition between freedom and determination collapses into bounded, tendency-weighted navigation.
Space, time, existence, and belief are removed from the category of independent additions and redistributed among arrangement, succession, manner, and force.
Fact and fiction become neighboring configurations differentiated not by elemental content but by composition, associative route, steadiness, provenance, and practical efficacy.
Causation becomes a cross-domain operator spanning perceptual genealogy, associative transition, productive capacity, social authority, belief-generation, and affective feedback.
Reading becomes operational and second-order: apparent entities must be decomposed into sources, configurations, force-transfers, exclusions, and corrective histories.
[Surface] The explicit field comprises human nature, impressions, ideas, memory, imagination, association, space, time, existence, belief, passion, fiction, and factual judgment.

[Structural] Copying, recurrence, separation, recombination, associative routing, ordered coexistence and succession, force-transfer, affective feedback, and correction form one distributed mechanism.
[Metastrategic] Metaphysical disputes are converted into audits of perceptual origin, relational operation, permissible application, causal pedigree, and susceptibility to correction.

[Ontological / Temporal] Reality available to thought consists of content-bearing events and configurations; time is generated succession recursively reorganized by memory, custom, expectation, and present practical force.

[Methodological / Performative] The system performs its claims by decomposing apparent unities, denying unsupported additions, reconstructing operational relations, testing them against anomalies, and replacing universality with qualified recursive regulation.

sections.name: Internal Tensions, Mutation Points, and Fault Lines

items.text: Causal succession, associative efficacy, force-transfer, and causal pedigree do indispensable explanatory work before causation itself has received a secured analysis.

The copy principle strains against the missing shade, abstraction’s selective suppression of detail, and the use of separability to deny forms that cannot be detached from every content-bearing instance.
The declared observational science of ordinary conduct remains incompletely integrated with introspective taxonomy, deprivation tests, and phenomenological judgments of force.
Association is both an original tendency and a customary acquisition, leaving unresolved how innate relational susceptibility and learned pathways divide explanatory labor.
Perceptual closure denies positive access to external actuality, yet sensory causation, reality-connection, and correction continue to invoke it as an operative constraint.
Force and vivacity classify impressions, memory, imagination, belief, passion, and counterfeit conviction without a stable metric or exact threshold across these functions.

Custom generates ordinary factual assent, but education, repetition, rhetoric, and pathology can use the same mechanism to generate invalid assent; causal genesis and warrant remain only partially separated.
General rules correct first-order force but lack an independently specified origin and authority, risking circular dependence on the beliefs and customs they are meant to regulate.
The science intended to secure all inquiry remains reflexive because it uses perception, comparison, causal inference, custom, and correction to establish the authority of those same operations.
Idea mutates from derivative copy into the common relay connecting sensation, reflection, recombination, order, association, belief, and action.
Order mutates from retained arrangement into a productive relation, spatiotemporal form, customary route, and condition of expectation.
Association mutates from a nonnecessary bond among ideas into the causal channel through which present experience selects factual alternatives and transfers vivacity.
Force mutates from a mark of perception-type into a transmissible psychological currency and then into a regulated quantity whose source matters more than its raw magnitude.
Existence mutates from an explicit ontological object into a zero-addition rule, while reality mutates into a causal and corrective relation governing belief.
Fiction mutates from lawful recombination into genealogical or doxastic excess when either its application outruns perceptual order or its vivacity imitates factual authority.
Reality is imaged as an asymmetrically grounded network of content-bearing events whose copied elements circulate through recursive circuits of order, association, and force.
The mind is an archive-workshop-routing system: it preserves sequences, cuts and recombines components, weights pathways, transfers intensity, and applies corrective feedback.
The subject is a switching relay and regulatory threshold rather than an originating substance; natural tendencies, habits, passions, bodily states, and reflection compete to direct its ideas.
Time is a pulse of content-bearing succession folded by memory and expectation, with present impressions drawing absent and future objects into current causal efficacy.

Navigation consists in tracing provenance, decomposing arrangements, following associative routes, measuring force by pedigree, correcting counterfeits, and stopping where perceptual relations no longer support explanation.
The current-level axioms are sufficient to reconstruct the engine if provenance, relational order, and intensive force remain distinct but recursively connected dimensions.
The strongest architecture is the conversion of restricted perceptual content into relationally productive and practically efficacious ideas without granting autonomous elemental creation.
The system is coherent at the operational level provided genetic priority, relational configuration, intensive manner, causal genesis, and epistemic warrant are not collapsed into one order.
The architecture remains underdetermined at the mechanisms of ideational return, associative attraction, vivacity transfer, exact thresholds of belief, and the authority of corrective rules.

Reconstruction preserves the actual movement only through sequencing and recursive return: sensory grounding must precede recombination, recombination must generate association, and existential non-addition must precede intensive belief.
The indispensable residues resistant to axiomatic reduction are sensory origin, the lived quality of force, mind-independent actuality, causal necessity, and the noncircular basis of correction.

The minimal reconstruction succeeds as a bounded naturalistic machine, not as metaphysical closure: it explains how perceptions generate order and reality-effects while preserving the absences that make such explanation necessary.

items.text: The central problem is how the same natural mechanisms can generate warranted causal judgment, metaphysical fiction, operational selfhood, affective valuation, and social hierarchy without access to intrinsic powers or an external rational tribunal.

The governing thesis is that relation-conditioned transitions become effective through force, vivacity, repetition, and retention; their outputs depend on how comparison, custom, circumstance, and social topology route them.

At this scale the argument becomes a recursive naturalistic reconstruction: substantial bearers, intrinsic powers, autonomous faculties, and primitive passions are displaced by networks of perceptions, affects, transitions, gates, and feedback.
The directional movement is foundational subtraction → operational transition → productive overextension → anomaly or contradiction → restrictive differentiation → socially recursive application.
Comparison becomes the principal branching operator: controlled difference isolates causal circumstances, while retained contrast converts another’s condition into an altered estimate of the self.

The social-affective field is not an external application of the cognitive system; it exposes how vivacity, authority, custom, and relation recursively produce the objects, values, and judgments they appear merely to register.
The subject accordingly mutates from a rejected substantial bearer into a temporally variable relay, represented object, comparator, and feedback-node within cognitive and social processes.

Closure is operational and recursively skeptical: inquiry preserves tested mechanisms while denying final decomposition, intrinsic value, affective neutrality, and any standpoint outside the operations under examination.
[Persistent] Legitimate explanation begins from perceptions, affects, experienced conjunctions, and observable transformations rather than from unknown substances or intrinsic productive powers.
[Persistent] Relation is causally effective only through the transitions it facilitates, preserves, interrupts, or redirects; it is not an inert predicate or an intrinsically binding nexus.
[Mutating] Force and vivacity migrate from determinants of conviction into the general currency by which cognitive, affective, and social representations become operative.
[Persistent] Repetition, habit, and custom stabilize transitions without converting psychological regularity, practical necessity, or social circulation into truth.
[Attractor] Imagination is the indispensable medium of synthesis and the endogenous source of fictive completion, overextension, constructed sentiment, and self-confirming error.
[Mutating] Comparison changes from controlled experimental differentiation into affective opposition, retaining the common operation of preserving difference while reversing its epistemic function.

[Mutating] Causation expands from regular conjunction among discriminated circumstances into gated conversion and recursive feedback in which effects alter subsequent causes, judgments, and relations.
[Emergent] Anomalies and contradictions reveal unrestricted principles by their excesses and force their conversion into range-bound, threshold-dependent mechanisms.
[Attractor] Normative correction is immanent: broader comparison, discriminating variation, skeptical restraint, and recursive audit regulate the same natural operations that generate error.
[Mutating] The self has no warranted status as a substantial origin but remains operative as a vivid relay, represented object, temporal comparator, and socially altered magnitude.
[Persistent] Natural production and felt efficacy do not establish representational truth, epistemic warrant, intrinsic value, or source-fidelity.
[Emergent] Social value is generated in circulation: transmitted satisfaction, reflected judgment, comparative opposition, and recursive uptake constitute rank and self-estimation.
[Emergent] Relational proximity and intensity possess no intrinsic valence; they amplify whichever epistemic, sympathetic, or comparative transformation controls the route.
[Emergent] Time is an active operator of projection, attenuation, retention, durable attribution, and feedback rather than a neutral container for stable objects and subjects.

[Terminal] The viable endpoint is a reflexive science of human nature that preserves empirically useful causal and affective mechanisms under permanent semantic, experimental, skeptical, and relational correction.
[Stable Identity] Experienced conjunction remains the minimum causal input, although its output expands from expectation to bodily influence, affective conversion, and social feedback.
[Escalation] Vivacity moves from explaining unequal conviction to animating belief and passion, then becomes the transmissible currency of a social-affective network.

[Mutation] Imagination changes from a producer of causal expectation and fictive object-unity into the general medium of cognition, then into a simulator capable of constructing another’s absent emotion.
[Functional Recurrence] Custom recurs as first-order projection, second-order regulation, affective stabilization, and constructive expectation, with renewed overextension at every phase.
[Reversal] Comparison changes from a corrective instrument that exposes suppressed differences into a social operator that preserves difference as inverse self-estimation.
[Migration] Relation migrates from conjunction, separability, and spatial compatibility into cognitive gating, self-reference, social proximity, directed transmission, and comparative interaction.
[Terminal Transformation] The self moves from an absent invariant bearer to an operational object and finally to a socially constituted relay-comparator whose states are generated through feedback.

[Escalation] Cause shifts from whole-object identity to operative circumstance, then to domain-specific conversion, and finally to nonlinear circuits in which generated passions modify their own conditions.
[Mutation] Contradiction changes from a stimulus for metaphysical repair into a diagnostic of unrestricted transition and then into a controlled anomaly for reconstructing social-affective routing.

[Disappearance] Substance, autonomous reason, intrinsic value, primitive social instinct, and sovereign selfhood disappear after their explanatory work is redistributed across relation, force, custom, comparison, and feedback.
[Lower-Layer Local] Particular rules for isolating causal circumstances remain local experimental instruments; their scalable function is recursive differentiation under counterinstance.
[Lower-Layer Local] Spatial compatibility, soul-substance, immortality, and the exact gates of pride and humility remain local problems rather than current-level explanatory centers.
[Lower-Layer Local] Fame, wealth-esteem, pity, envy, malice, and the constitutional conjunctions of love or hatred remain local outputs of the broader relational machine.
[Scaled] Relation-mediated force scales upward as the common architecture connecting belief, causal inference, affective conversion, and social valuation.

[Bridge] Experimental circumstance-analysis and affective threshold-gating jointly establish that causal mechanisms are individuated by controlled differences in routing, not by whole-object classification.
[Bridge] The operational self of the skeptical and affective analyses becomes the relay-comparator required by social transmission and reflected valuation.
[Catalyst] Social anomalies demonstrate that unchanged content or objective condition can generate opposed effects, forcing causation to include sequence, topology, retention, and mode selection.
[Recoded] Causal identity is recoded from an intrinsic power or whole object into a reproducible transformation distributed across input, relation, force, gate, and feedback.
[Current-Level Emergent] Philosophy becomes a reflexive regulation of cognitive and social-affective machinery rather than a separate faculty judging nature from outside.
No substantial bearer, intrinsic causal power, or affective essence is required where relations and transformations among perceptions can perform the explanatory work.
No autonomous reason, sovereign self, or neutral tribunal can validate cognition and value independently of imagination, habit, affect, and social relation.
Relation is not static, symmetric, intrinsically efficacious, or valence-bearing; its force depends on direction, continuity, comparison, competition, and mediation.
Stable content, representation, or objective condition does not guarantee stable belief, judgment, passion, or value.
Imagination and custom can neither be granted unrestricted authority nor eliminated, because both successful operation and systematic error depend on them.
No unrestricted explanatory principle survives: causal uniformity, pure understanding, universal relation, and primitive passion-laws all require domain, threshold, or circumstance restrictions.
Neither felt conviction nor sympathetic uptake guarantees warrant, truth, intrinsic worth, or faithful access to another’s interior state.
No final correction abolishes custom, closes causal decomposition, fixes self-worth, or establishes a nonparticipatory position outside the relational system.
The architecture requires the falsity of any model that assigns cognition, passion, and social valuation to autonomous faculties governed by independent laws.
It requires an external standpoint to be unavailable: correction must occur through reorganized experience, comparison, custom, and relation rather than through an Archimedean criterion.
It excludes purely linear causality because belief reinforces repetition, passion recruits judgment, esteem amplifies satisfaction, and altered relations become new causes.
It cannot admit an invariant subject whose identity, rationality, and worth remain insulated from temporal force, remembered relation, testimony, and comparison.
It excludes universal commensurability: epistemic warrant, conviction, pleasure, welfare, public esteem, and comparative self-value cannot be reduced to one scale.
It also excludes absolute irregularity, because recursive correction requires provisionally stable kinds, repeatable transitions, retained impressions, and reproducible relational effects.
It cannot admit an affect-free methodology, because evidential uptake, inquiry, skeptical recovery, authority, and correction remain operations of force within human nature.
The system is organized around an absent metaphysical interior: neither causal power, substantial self, nor another person’s authentic feeling is directly available as an explanatory ground.
The deepest unavailable possibility is a common metric capable of aligning truth, felt conviction, welfare, social esteem, and self-worth.
No view from outside human nature can determine the legitimacy of custom, imagination, sympathy, or comparison without using those same operations.
No final alignment joins what nature produces to what is true or good; natural belief, practical stability, social value, and affective intensity can all diverge from warrant and welfare.
The architecture lacks a general metric for mode selection and activation: it cannot finally specify when custom becomes rule, relation becomes force, or sympathy yields to comparison.
Final repose is inadmissible because every stabilization can become a new habit, fiction, hierarchy, or compound circumstance requiring renewed differentiation.

Causal judgment and social passion are two scales of one natural engine: relation organizes transition, force makes it operative, and gating determines whether the result becomes inference, fiction, attachment, or comparison.
Comparison bifurcates normatively: controlled difference corrects causal projection, whereas retained contrast can intensify envy or self-elevation without improving truth-tracking.

The distinction between warrant and conviction extends into the social field: authority, praise, familiarity, and reflected esteem can amplify assent or self-belief independently of evidential regularity.
Once the substantial self is removed, cognitive and social analyses converge on a subject constituted by incoming force, retained relations, comparative positioning, and recursive self-attribution.
Constructive sympathy extends the theory of endogenous error: a representation can generate a real affective consequence even when it does not faithfully reproduce its alleged source.

General rules are simultaneously corrective and productive: they can restrain prejudicial inference, stabilize inquiry, or construct expected passions that reinforce the social model from which they arose.
Causal explanation becomes irreducibly recursive in the social domain because outputs such as belief, hatred, esteem, and envy alter the judgments and relations governing subsequent transitions.

Strategic intervention follows the same logic as experiment: instead of positing new faculties, alter authority, proximity, concurrence, associative continuity, or comparative framing and observe the transformed output.

Social topology becomes epistemically relevant because testimony and judgment acquire force through authority and relation; inquiry must therefore distinguish evidential content from its route of affective uptake.
Moderate skepticism cannot require affective neutrality; it must regulate the unavoidable forces by which custom, curiosity, testimony, and social relations sustain inquiry.
Ontology becomes an operational field of heterogeneous events connected by recurrent, force-bearing, and directionally weighted transitions without known substantial support.
The subject becomes a distributed effect of organization: impressions, habits, memories, testimony, comparisons, and reflected sentiments converge temporarily as self-reference.

Epistemic normativity becomes topological and regulatory: warrant depends on how transitions survive counterinstance, variation, competing routes, and recursive feedback rather than on their subjective force alone.
Social reality is causally productive rather than representationally secondary: circulated affect generates rank, self-estimation, attachment, antagonism, and the evidential force of judgments.
Time becomes recursively constitutive: repetition projects futures, distance modulates conviction, retention enables comparison, and reflected consequences become new present causes.
Human agency is non-sovereign but strategically variable: subjects cannot suspend the machinery of transition, yet they can alter routes, circumstances, associations, and comparative fields.
Error is not external noise but productive excess internal to successful machinery; every mechanism capable of stabilizing cognition or society can also fabricate ontology, sentiment, or hierarchy.
The science of human nature becomes experimentally recursive: anomalies are treated as variations revealing hidden routing conditions rather than as immediate grounds for inventing new faculties.
No ethical or epistemic virtue inheres in connectedness itself; intensified relation can support disciplined comparison, prejudice, sympathy, rivalry, or self-confirming passion.

sections.name: Recursive Loops, Escalation Paths, and Conceptual Attractors

items.text: Repetition → custom → facilitated transition → vivified belief or action → renewed conjunction forms the basal cognitive loop.
Fluent transition → projected unity or power → contradiction → fictive repair or controlled differentiation forms the principal epistemic bifurcation.
General mechanism → anomalous output → restrictive gating → provisional stabilization → renewed anomaly forms the meta-cluster’s dominant escalation sequence.
Inquiry → skeptical intensification → affective interruption → natural restoration → constrained inquiry forms the recurrent anti-foundational spiral.
Sign or condition → represented affect → vivacity transfer or construction → passion → judgment or desire → altered condition forms the social feedback loop.
Satisfaction → sympathetic esteem → reflected esteem → intensified satisfaction forms a status-producing loop in which social value recursively augments its own cause.
Comparison → altered self-position → passion → attention to the comparative relation → intensified or severed comparison forms the recursive rivalry loop.
“Relation” becomes the principal machine when it expands from observed connection into a directed infrastructure governing inference, attribution, simulation, comparison, and intervention.
Human nature is the hidden attractor: causal method, skeptical regulation, selfhood, passion, and social hierarchy converge on the recursive organization of relation-mediated force.

sections.name: Formal Generative Schema of the Whole Book

items.text: Initialize heterogeneous perceptions, qualities, pleasures, pains, persons, and represented conditions without an independently appearing support.
Organize inputs through conjunction, resemblance, contiguity, succession, self-reference, authority, proximity, durability, and directed relational pathways.
Add force through vivacity, pleasure, pain, passion, retained impression, or customary propensity; relation without force remains explanatorily incomplete.
Repetition and general rules stabilize transitions into expectation, attribution, self-reference, and socially anticipated affect.
Route stabilized force through causal projection, imaginative completion, sympathetic appropriation, or comparative opposition to generate belief, object-unity, passion, and social value.
Detect excess through contrary instance, fictive ontology, contradictory belief, affective overgeneration, reversed valence, or self-confirming judgment.
Bifurcate excess into simulated closure or controlled restriction through semantic audit, circumstance-analysis, skeptical diffidence, threshold-gating, and relational rerouting.
Feed generated beliefs and passions back into custom, judgment, authority, reflected esteem, and comparative positioning, thereby modifying subsequent inputs and routes.
Submit every provisional stabilization to renewed variation, including the rules, classifications, and social models produced by earlier correction.
Terminate only metaphysical completion: preserve recursive empirical and social-affective inquiry while withholding final necessity, intrinsic baseline, and external validation.
Hidden substance, intrinsic power, autonomous reason, and primitive passion → demand for experiential and operational justification.
Justificatory demand → decomposition into perceptions, qualities, affects, conjunctions, and relations.
Decomposition → relation-conditioned transition animated by force, vivacity, repetition, and custom.
Animated transition → belief, projected unity, apparent placement, self-attribution, sympathy, and comparison.
Unrestricted transition → prejudice, metaphysical fiction, contradictory belief, affective overgeneration, and reversed social valence.
Excess and anomaly → controlled difference, semantic restraint, skeptical restriction, relational gating, and mode differentiation.
Restricted mechanism → recursive belief, reflected esteem, passion-generated judgment, and strategic alteration of relational routes.
Recursive feedback → nonterminal science of human nature constrained by experiment and skepticism but lacking final thresholds, intrinsic baselines, or external closure.
The substance–faculty map is replaced by a field of heterogeneous events, directed relations, force-bearing transitions, and recursive outputs.
Reason, imagination, passion, and error cease to name autonomous agencies and become differently regulated phases of one natural economy.
Causation is redrawn as a transformation architecture: conjunction supplies repeatability, relation supplies routing, force supplies efficacy, and gating supplies differential output.
The self is reclassified from hidden bearer to a temporally extended and socially permeable relay-comparator.
Evidence becomes multidimensional: comparative regularity determines warrant, vivacity determines uptake, and social topology determines which judgments acquire force.
Comparison is split into experimental discrimination and affective inversion, dissolving any assumption that heightened contrast is intrinsically rational or irrational.
Social hierarchy is reclassified as recursively generated affective adjacency rather than the passive registration of intrinsic rank.
Error becomes a phase of productive machinery whose limits are disclosed through overgeneration rather than a foreign corruption added to otherwise pure faculties.
Intervention and interpretation shift from naming hidden entities to varying circumstances, tracing routes, separating force from content, and testing how feedback transforms the field.
Surface level: causal judgment, substance and soul, skeptical inquiry, pride and humility, reputation, affection, pity, envy, and malice appear as distinct explicit problems.
Structural level: relation, repetition, vivacity, imagination, comparison, custom, retention, and feedback generate and differentiate the surface phenomena.
Metastrategic level: inquiry intervenes by widening comparison, varying circumstances, restricting overgeneralization, and rerouting authority or proximity rather than invoking new faculties.
Ontological / Temporal level: reality is a field of heterogeneous events in ordered and retained relations; identity, causation, selfhood, and value are provisional products of temporal organization.
Social / Political level: authority, publicity, custom, reflected esteem, proximity, and comparison distribute the force by which judgments and hierarchies become operative.

Methodological / Performative level: the architecture performs its thesis by producing excess, converting anomaly into controlled variation, and recursively subjecting its own rules and stabilizations to renewed audit.

sections.name: Internal Tensions, Mutation Points, and Fault Lines

items.text: The same custom and imagination generate error and correction, leaving the distinction between legitimate and illegitimate transition immanent and never completely secured.
Necessary connection is denied, yet causal method depends on strong uniformity, stable kinds, and reproducible transitions whose practical authority exceeds their ontological grounding.
A common transition architecture must explain heterogeneous outputs, but each domain introduces gates and constitutional supplements that resist complete unification.
The substantial self is rejected, yet correction, passion, memory, and comparison require persistent self-reference whose continuity remains operationally necessary but ontologically unspecified.
Force and relation are indispensable explanatory variables, but no quantitative rule determines sufficient vivacity, adequate repetition, decisive relation, or conversion threshold.
Sympathy and comparison can derive opposed affects from the same condition, but the architecture lacks a general selector determining which mode dominates.
Nature restores belief, action, and affective order without vindicating them, preserving a structural separation between practical efficacy and epistemic or ethical legitimacy.

Corrective inquiry is itself socially and affectively routed through authority, curiosity, testimony, and vivacity, threatening any claim that experimental regulation is insulated from the mechanisms it diagnoses.
Relation mutates from observed conjunction into a directed and weighted infrastructure for causation, self-reference, sympathy, comparison, and intervention.
Vivacity mutates from a measure of conviction into the common activation threshold for belief, passion, social transmission, and self-alteration.
Imagination mutates from associative completion into a general productive medium and finally into constructive social simulation.
Comparison mutates from experimental control into a social operation that converts retained affect into inverse self-evaluation.
The self mutates from excluded substance into operational object and then into a socially generated magnitude within recursive feedback.
Cause mutates from whole-object identity into discriminated circumstance, gated conversion, and feedback circuit.
Skepticism mutates from denial of intrinsic power into recurrent regulation of cognitive and social-affective mechanisms without terminating their operation.

Reality appears as a recursive laboratory-network: heterogeneous events form nodes, relations form weighted pathways, force animates transmission, and feedback continually alters the field being investigated.
The subject is a permeable relay-comparator that receives force, projects expectation, simulates others, measures itself through retained differences, and returns the result as judgment or action.
Time is a nested circuit rather than a line: repetition becomes projection, retained affect becomes comparison, durable attribution becomes identity, and reflected consequence becomes new cause.

The remaining struggle is over routing rather than transcendence: viable correction alters circumstances, relations, authorities, associations, and comparative distances while remaining inside the machinery of human nature.

The axioms are sufficient to reconstruct the meta-cluster if unsupported heterogeneity, relation-mediated force, customary stabilization, differential gating, recursive feedback, and immanent correction are retained together.
The architecture remains underdetermined concerning stable kinds, adequate repetition, causal individuation, mode selection, relation thresholds, and the continuity of the operational self.
The system is coherent at this scale as a recursive operational naturalism, not as a deductive foundation, unified metric, or final reconciliation of cognition and affect.

Its strongest architecture is the conversion of failed intrinsic explanations into a distributed machine capable of generating belief, error, selfhood, passion, hierarchy, and their correction from related operations.
Reconstruction preserves the actual movement only if foundational subtraction is followed by operational return, and operational return by anomaly, restriction, feedback, and renewed audit.

The architecture is weakest where it assigns regulatory authority to broader custom, experiment, moderation, or social certification without fully deriving their superiority from the machinery they regulate.

The indispensable residue resistant to axiomatic reduction is differential force and selection: neither the intensity activating a transition nor the rule choosing among projection, sympathy, direct survey, and comparison is fully calculable.
